title: k8s node lifecycle debugging scratchpad
content:
Notes: Investigating repeated node churn in eu-west-1 cluster (pool: gpu-pool-3).

Timeline:
- 2025-11-12 09:40 UTC: first alert - nodes entering NotReady, pods evicted.
- 2025-11-12 10:05 UTC: repro attempt, recreated node via ASG, same behavior after bootstrap.

Commands tried / outputs:
- kubectl get nodes -o wide
  OUTPUT: 3 NotReady (KubeletNotReady) with Age < 10m
- kubectl describe node ip-10-0-2-45.eu-west-1.compute.internal
  ERROR: "Failed to start kubelet: failed to register node: node IP mismatch"
- journalctl -u kubelet -b --no-pager | tail -n 200
  SNIPPET: "E11012 09:58:13.345678 kubelet.go:234] node IP reported as 10.0.3.45, cloud provider expects 10.0.2.45"
- cat /var/log/cloud-init.log
  SNIPPET: cloud-init configured hostname incorrectly (missing route53 update)
- helm upgrade --install node-provisioner ./charts/node-provisioner --values values.yaml
  OUTPUT: release skaffold-node-provisioner deployed

Hypotheses:
1) cloud-init userdata sets network interface order inconsistently -> kubelet picks wrong node IP -> registration fails with IP mismatch.
2) AWS ENI attachment timing race: kubelet starts before secondary ENI is attached; cloud-provider reports public IP mismatch.
3) Helm chart change last week (PR #517) introduced hostname override that conflicts with cloud-init.

Quick repro steps:
- Spin new instance from ami ami-0abcd1234 with same launch template
- watch /var/log/cloud-init.log and journalctl -u kubelet
- verify ip addr show; check metadata service (curl http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/local-ipv4)

Temporary mitigations tried:
- Set kubelet --node-ip to metadata local-ip in systemd drop-in (worked on single node in repro but not cluster-wide)
- Added preStart hook in bootstrap to sleep 30s before kubelet start (reduced failures by ~60%)

Open questions / TODO:
- [ ] Confirm if ENI attach events are delayed on m6i.gpu instances (ask infra team)
- [ ] Reproduce with different AMI to rule out cloud-init change
- [ ] Rollback PR #517 in staging and observe
- [ ] Add metadata-based node-ip injection in bootstrap (safer than hostname override)

Relevant links:
- JIRA: PROV-842 (incident)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/517
- Slack thread: #infra-node-provisioning (link in JIRA)

Notes to self:
- Keep debugging notes noisy; will clean into a postmortem once root cause confirmed.
- If we confirm cloud-init race, need migration plan to update launch template and CLI docs.

Commands to run next:
- aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --filters "Name=attachment.instance-id,Values=i-0abcd12345" --region eu-west-1
- ssh into failing node; run `ip route` and `ip addr` and confirm metadata local-ip

End of scratchpad.
